mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the draining tissue spaces to the lymph return route was most worthwhile: it showed the whole path back to a vein and explained that the fluid is called lymph once it enters the vessels.

leastWorthwhile.text: The failed attempt to connect the draining spaces to the larger vessels was confusing because their pictures seemed to fit together.

surprise.text: Inspecting the return route automatically joined it to the draining spaces, even though my earlier attempt starting with the draining spaces had failed.

arbitrary.text: The operand order felt arbitrary: the pictures did not make it clear why starting with the draining spaces failed but starting with the completed return route worked.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see how another body system connects to the model. The clear pictures helped, although the unexplained combination restriction was frustrating.
